Regulation: B.C. Reg. 124/2026
Made under: Forest Act
Published in: No. 13 – B.C. Regs. 110 to 124, July 14, 2026
Deposit date: July 13, 2026

B.C. Reg. 124/2026, deposited July 13, 2026, under theFOREST ACT[sections 151 (1.01), (1.1) and (2) and 151.9 (1)]. Order in Council 326/2026, approved and ordered July 13, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that the BC Timber Sales Regulation, B.C. Reg. 381/2008, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — R. PARMAR,Minister of Forests; A. DIX,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section 2 of the BC Timber Sales Regulation, B.C. Reg. 381/2008, is amended by adding the following paragraph: (c)	Category 5 – Custom Cutters and Processors, comprising persons described in section 5.2. 2	Section 3 (3) (c) is amended by adding "a" before "BC timber sales agreement". (a)	by repealing subsection (1) and substituting the following: (1)	A person may be registered as a BC timber sales enterprise in Category 4 – Value-added if the person (a)	meets the requirements under subsections (1.1) and (2), and (b)	applies to the timber sales manager in a manner approved by the manager., (b)	by adding the following subsection: (1.1)	In order to qualify for registration under this section, (a)	a person must, throughout the calendar year immediately preceding the date on which the person applies for registration, have owned or leased an eligible value-added processing facility in British Columbia, and (b)	during that calendar year, the facility must have had at least 1 600 hours of operation in which at least one production worker worked at the facility in the production of an eligible value-added product., (c)	in subsection (2) by striking out "qualify for registration" and substituting "be registered", (d)	in subsection (2) (c) (i) by striking out "a category under this regulation" and substituting "Category 1 – Market or Category 4 – Value-added", (e)	in subsection (2) by adding "and" at the end of paragraph (c) (ii) and by repealing paragraph (d), and (f)	in subsection (2) (e) by striking out "m3" and substituting "m3". 4	The following section is added: Registration, Category 5 – Custom Cutters and Processors

minutes_briefs.title: New Category 5 for Custom Cutters and Processors under BC Timber Sales Regulation
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has amended the BC Timber Sales Regulation to add a new registration category, Category 5 – Custom Cutters and Processors, for people who cut and process timber on a custom basis. The amendment also tightens the rules for Category 4 – Value-added registration, requiring applicants to have owned or leased an eligible value-added processing facility in BC for the full previous calendar year and to have operated it for at least 1,600 hours with at least one production worker during that year. These changes affect how timber sales enterprises register and operate in the province.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you are a custom cutter or processor, review the new Category 5 registration requirements and apply to the timber sales manager if you qualify.
